counts.note: Logical table assertions count each field equality/reference/error. Static assert sites are not runtime loop/subtest counts. No behavior was executed and no compatibility PASS is asserted.

mechanicalEvidence.purpose: unittest discovery only and fixture static schema/ASCII IDs/12-kind checks

P3Execution.executionOwner: root uniform first run; keep all first failures before batch repair

sourceCoverageNotes: Handwritten grammar/DB semantic parameter rows and independent source-default rows; no candidate-generated expected values.
Dedicated CoSE/tidy/fCoSE numerical/containment/order/constraint tests plus actual CPU paint content, geometry, CSS inheritance and swimlane overlay checks.
Source spec inventories preserve source parameter/helper sites, but do not claim wholesale Jest migration or all source assertions passed.
An upstream invalid architecture group endpoint, explicit static-scope interaction exclusion, and currently unconsumed icon metadata remain separately identified.

P3Questions.source: RequirementDB RiskLevel/VerifyType stores capitalized Low/Medium/High and Analysis/Demonstration/Inspection/Test; native frozen fields may retain input spelling. Source expectations remain capitalized.
P3Questions.action: Preserve first failures then compare official DB/paint; do not change expectation merely to pass.

P3Questions.source: NODE_DESC greedy class includes minus before a ) closer for unquoted (-Title-); table expects Title- while getType default.
P3Questions.action: Official first parse capture must confirm lexical behavior.

P3Questions.source: Current unified mindmap/kanban metadata icon has no standalone glyph consumer; metadata is retained, render fixture classified source_unconsumed by feature.
P3Questions.action: Confirm official captures before concluding no glyph native parity.

P3Questions.source: Native numerical adaptation is not proven equivalent by implementation completion. Tests require actual alignment/gap/compound containment/nonoverlap/randomize determinism and readable captures.
P3Questions.action: Any force overlap, dropped constraint/child or label clipping fails; omission of pruning/regrowth optimization does not count as functionality PASS.

P3Questions.source: Source stores LL/RR/TT/BB edge but excludes it from adjacency; retained fixture render expectation needs first official result.
P3Questions.action: Keep first source errors if any and classify upstream defect only with evidence.

P3Questions.source: Tests inspect documented native trace/scene geometry roles to bind independent source content and actual shapes; role vocabulary is not itself the compatibility goal.
P3Questions.action: If a purely renamed role causes failure, confirm source actual content/geometry and retain original failure before source-backed test adjustment.

limitations: All behavior, official parsing/rendering, pixel comparisons and hardware/export integration remain unexecuted in P2.
A successful discovery/compile proves mechanical validity only, not source parity or readability.
Dedicated force algorithm numerical adaptation and source anomalies require actual P3 evidence; pruning/regrowth omission is not a compatibility PASS.
